items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED CONTROLS/MECHANICS: WASD moves the character; short taps (~0.3-0.5s) move slightly, holds of ~1-2.5s move much farther; overall movement is slow relative to screen, and the camera scrolls with the character. Space = 'Do Action' (confirmed in Controls menu): contextual harvest/interact, works only when very close and the target is not occluded. Hovering a target shows a verb label: 'Pick Flower/Sapling/Grass' when in range, 'Examine X' when out of range or occluded. LMB selects/examines world objects and does not harvest. Escape opens a Paused menu (Continue, Controls, Settings, Save, Quit). Controls list showed: Primary LMB, Secondary RMB, Force Inspect Left Alt, Force Attack Left Ctrl, Do Attack F, Do Action Space, Move W/S/A/D; scrolling the list did not scroll and no dedicated craft key was shown. Picked items enter bottom inventory slots after ~1s animation delay. Ground twig drops appear to auto-collect when walked over. Tab toggles map (only a tiny explored patch visible). Resource yields: white flowers->petals (slot 1), spiky saplings->twigs (slot 2, sometimes leaves a ground twig), yellow spiky grass tufts->grass (slot 3). Grass tufts are frequently at pine-tree bases where the trunk overlaps/occludes them; must aim precisely at tuft pixels. Approaching a tuft from the wrong side yields 'Examine Grass' instead of 'Pick Grass'. Birds, a red bird, rabbit holes, and at dusk fireflies were seen; a red-eyed crow appeared at night. Lighting: fireflies at dusk, screen dims progressively to full darkness with a starry vignette; in darkness the character was hit repeatedly ('OW! Something hit me!', 'What was that?!') and total darkness previously ended the run (death) with no light source. CRAFTING UI: left sidebar has category icons (axe at ~y0.13, flame 'Light' at ~y0.185, plus trap/yarn/sword/cup/survival lower). Clicking an icon changes the top-left category label; after clicking the flame icon at x~0.026 the sidebar expanded into a column of wooden recipe tiles at x~0.117 (icons mostly dark silhouettes; possible torch-like, pointed, cauldron/furnace, hand shapes). No tooltips or ingredient text appeared even after ~1.5s hover dwell. Clicking the top Light tile twice produced no visible crafted item or inventory change. A scroll/document icon at bottom-right (~0.93,0.89) is unexplored. FAILED STRATEGIES: click-to-harvest (only selects/examines); pressing Space from slightly too far or through a tree trunk (occlusion); expecting recipe tooltips/costs to render; assuming clicking a recipe tile crafts it (no observed effect); assuming S opens a crafting menu (it moves down); spamming category clicks hoping for a flyout (initially produced nothing); wasting daylight on UI debugging instead of gathering; attempting grass tufts at trunk bases without repositioning. UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES (guesses, unconfirmed): dark recipe silhouettes may mean 'insufficient ingredients' vs 'unaffordable/locked'; a torch or campfire likely lives under Light and likely costs grass plus twigs (started with 1 grass + 1-2 twigs; tiles stayed dark); recipe activation might require something other than a tile click (e.g., Space with a recipe selected, a hover-then-click, or the bottom-right scroll icon). LESSONS FOR NEXT RUN: gather grass and twigs in quantity early, resolve the exact craft activation before dusk, keep out of total darkness (it is lethal and triggers attacks), verify proximity via the hover verb label before pressing Space, approach trunk-base tufts from the open side, and avoid repeating UI interactions that showed no response.
